verdict.rationale: Superset clearly lets a developer step into a running agent's workspace and steer it. Each workspace pairs the agent with terminals, code review and browser previews (superset-gh-3). Automation runs produce a live workspace you can open and continue interactively (superset-docs-20). You can send diff-line feedback or browser-pane Design element changes to a running agent session (superset-gh-1, superset-gh-2), and you get notified when an agent pauses for input (superset-docs-11). Missing for 10: no evidence of opening a workspace in an external editor/IDE to hand-edit the agent's work, no explicit documentation of a 'take over' flow, and only light independent corroboration (a community note on persistent terminals).
